processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ingot heated to 1200°C and held for 2 h, then hot forged into billets of 100 x 100 mm cross-section.

Plate-shaped specimens (thicknesses 1.5, 2, 3.5, and 10 mm) were excised from the center of the billet along the forging direction; all specimens were solution treated at 1000°C for 1 h and water-quenched to room temperature (undeformed reference state; no cryogenic rolling applied).

phases_present.morphology: equiaxed grains with straight grain boundaries

microstructure_list.region: bulk cross-section (samples prepared along rolling direction)

structures.overall_structure: Equiaxed austenite grain morphology with straight grain boundaries; a few annealing twins and dislocations dispersed within the grains; single-phase austenitic (FCC) structure.
